public.text: The Ministry of Finance value case focuses on budget execution, leakage, provider payment, and administrative efficiency. It gives less attention to care quality, equity, resilience, workforce productivity, public trust, and the cost of failing infrastructure.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand the value case and distinguish monetisable savings, avoided costs, service improvements, equity benefits, resilience, and wider public value.
